{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |year=2017–18 |team=Texas Longhorns |sport=Basketball |image=Texas Longhorns logo.svg |conference=Big 12 Conference |short_conf= Big 12 |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=19–15 |conf_record=8–10 |head_coach=[[Shaka Smart]] |hc_year=3rd |asst_coach1=[[Darrin Horn]] |asst_coach2=[[Jai Lucas]] |asst_coach3=Mike Morell |stadium=[[Frank Erwin Center]] |tourney=[[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Round }} {{2017–18 Big 12 men's basketball standings}} [[File:20170329 MCDAAG Mohamed Bamba dribbling.jpg|right|thumb|Texas recruit [[Mo Bamba]] at the [[2017 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]]]] The '''2017–18 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by third-year head coach [[Shaka Smart]], and played their home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, Texas]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 19–15, 8–10 in [[2017–18 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in seventh place. They defeated [[2017–18 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] in the first round of the [[2018 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]]{{Cite news|url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/iowa-state/basketball-mens/2018/03/07/what-we-learned-texas-68-iowa-state-basketball-64-big-12-basketball-tournament/403078002/|title=What we learned: Texas 68, Iowa State 64|work=Des Moines Register|access-date=2018-04-05|language=en}} before losing to [[2017–18 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite news|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/texas-loses-to-texas-tech-but-beats-adversity-in-big-12-quarterfinals/|title=Texas loses to Texas Tech, but beats adversity, in Big 12 quarterfinals|work=CBSSports.com|access-date=2018-04-05|language=en}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 10 seed in the South region, where they lost to [[2017–18 Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball team|Nevada]] in the first round 87–83 in OT.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401025817|title=Texas vs. Nevada - Game Recap - March 16, 2018 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2018-04-05}}{{Cite news|url=https://sportsday.dallasnews.com/college-sports/collegesports/2018/03/16/texas-vs-nevada-basketball-live-updates|title=Nevada 87, Texas 83: Recap, analysis, reaction and more from the Longhorns' loss|date=2018-03-16|work=SportsDay|access-date=2018-04-05|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Longhorns]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 11–22, 4–14 in [[2016–17 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in last place.
